closedSoftwareGaps: Shared Geraina/DapurOS identities and staff-only membership erasure
Transaction-level account/module/store/membership fencing in both backends
Approved minimum financial/time retention, explicit expiry and due-only purge
Durable begin/resume/status/cancel, lost-response retry and restore replay

checks: Concurrent first writes create guards safely and preserve all six increments
Closure waits for an existing transaction and rejects the now-stale preview without losing the committed write
Real Geraina HTTP cash checkout, duplicate retry, void/stock restoration and offline synchronization retain their existing atomic behavior behind the fence
A real Geraina HTTP request authenticated before closure is fenced at its later write; closing access is visible through normal authentication
An actual mid-erasure database failure rolls back records and retention copies; durable closure remains resumable
Retry after an interruption or lost success response returns the durable result without duplicate retention copies; old sessions reject
Overall completion requires a separately recorded outcome for every external-copy step; the database result alone never reports full completion
Real retention projection excludes identity/contact/provider fields; the TTL index is installed and deterministic expiry removes only due data
Independent DapurOS HTTP login and product writes work during and after Geraina closure; shared credentials and the DapurOS paid entitlement survive
Staff-only erasure preserves sales totals, removes attribution, reopens the store to its owner and still fences the erased staff identity
Cancellation before commit safely reopens writes; restored records stay fenced and reviewed restore replay removes them without affecting another tenant
All supported Mongo mutation shapes are fenced, unscoped upserts fail closed, and nested helpers share the outer session without a self-deadlock
Actual operator CLI preview, begin, status, resume/retry and external-step acknowledgements pass against the marked local fixture
Actual built frontend passed Playwright sign-in, closed-account reload/login, staff logout and surviving-owner access on desktop and phone layouts
